description: There is no notification system: errors go to alert() (blocks the page) or only to the console, so failed saves can pass unnoticed. Add one small toast store + component (info / warning / error, auto-dismiss, stacked, keyboard-safe) and route existing alert() calls and swallowed mutation errors through it. First new consumer: read-only edit warnings.

status.comment: Toast store + ToastStack implemented and verified in the running app; awaiting Felix's acceptance.

reflection: stores/toast.ts (info 4s / warning 8s auto-dismiss, errors sticky, repeats counted ×N, max 5) + components/ToastStack.vue (aria-live, never takes focus) mounted in App.vue. main.ts routes Vue errorHandler and unhandledrejection to toasts. Replaced alert() in GraphView (relax), ConsistencyModal, PhaseCreationModal; swallowed errors now toast: move/paste actions, position flush ('Failed to save positions'), graph connect, live-update subscription drop. Destructive confirm() prompts kept on purpose. Verified: toast.spec.ts (2 tests), vue-tsc clean, pnpm check 25/25, live app screenshot shows error ×2 + info toast. Note: puppeteer MCP re-wraps console.error per call, which recursed during smoke testing; harness artifact, not app code.
